acceptable_paraphrases: Other shapes like a rectangle or X can have rotational symmetry of order 4
It is not limited to squares, other shapes such as rectangles or stars can also have rotational symmetry of order 4
Rotational symmetry of order 4 is not exclusive to squares
misconceptions: Only squares can have rotational symmetry of order 4
Any shape can have a rotation of 4 regardless of its sides or angles
Rotational symmetry of 4 is only for square-like shapes
grading_notes: Students who correctly identify that other shapes can have rotational symmetry of order 4 will receive full credit. Incorrect statements about the exclusivity to squares, or misconceptions about 'any shape' should be penalized.
